query:
SELECT ci.id, ci.invoiceNumber, ci.totalAmountCents, ci.status, ci.paidAt,
       ca.businessName, ca.assignedTechnicianId
FROM client_invoices ci
JOIN client_accounts ca ON ca.id = ci.clientAccountId
WHERE ca.id IN (30001, 60001)
ORDER BY ci.id;
